Olivia Chen: Hey team — quick question. I bought a local prepaid SIM while in Prague on the corp card (Ramp ****1234) for 15 EUR on 2025-09-14. Vendor only gave a handwritten receipt. Can I expense this? Also is VAT refundable for a tiny SIM purchase?

Marco Perez: Upload a photo of the receipt to Ramp and put the merchant name in the notes. For small local purchases like that we usually allow it if there's a clear proof of purchase.

Olivia Chen: Uploaded the pic and added the phone number — thanks. The receipt has no VAT number though.

Jasper (Finance Ops): Short answer: we can't reclaim EU VAT unless we have a proper VAT invoice (vendor VAT number + line items). For a 15 EUR prepaid SIM, reclaiming VAT is generally not worth the admin unless the vendor issues a formal invoice.

Jasper (Finance Ops): That said, the personal expense policy allows connectivity needed for work to be charged to the corp card. We'll code it as "connectivity/mobile" on the claim. Make sure you tag the trip project code.

Olivia Chen: Got it. Do I need manager approval for this? It's small but international.

Marco Perez: No extra approval needed on my side for <50 EUR. I approve. :thumbsup:

Olivia Chen: Thanks! Two more quick ones — 1) If the vendor later emails an invoice with VAT details, can we still submit for VAT reclaim? 2) If not reclaimable, do I need to submit anything else to reconcile non-reclaimable VAT?

Jasper (Finance Ops): 1) Yes — if they provide a proper invoice we can attempt reclaiming retroactively, but we need the original transaction and the invoice matching date/amount. 2) If no reclaim, just leave it as expense amount = 15 EUR. We track reclaimable vs non-reclaimable in the Ramp note. No extra paperwork beyond the receipt photo.

Emily (People Ops): Small policy note — if you had used personal funds then reimbursing for connectivity under 75 EUR is handled via the normal expenses flow; corp card is preferred for speed.

Olivia Chen: Perfect, thanks everyone. I'll leave it as "connectivity/mobile" and tag project RED-13.

ExpenseBot: Reminder: Uploaded receipt (1912345600-olivia-sim.jpg) queued for review. Status: pending finance approval.

Jasper (Finance Ops): We'll mark approved and close out. If vendor later sends VAT invoice, DM me and we'll reopen for reclaim.

Olivia Chen: Will do — appreciate it! :raised_hands:
